summary.text: Father of warlike Asteropaeus (`asteropaeus-paeonian`), whom wide-flowing Axius begot on Periboea daughter of Acessamenus — named when the Paeonian captain vaunted his river descent to Achilles beside Scamander.

story.text: When Asteropaeus leapt from the eddying Scamander to face Achilles, he boasted that he was sprung from a river-god, Pelegon, whom wide-flowing Axius begot upon Periboea daughter of Acessamenus — yet the son of Peleus fixed him with the Pelian ash and left him in the sands.
